title: 第三章：美食不可辜负！
content_zh:
“妈妈央求羯斯噶叔叔给你要了马，你以后再也不用骑着老盘羊追杀米满他们了。”
娜哈热热的呼吸弄得云初耳朵痒痒的，他反手在娜哈的屁股上拍了一巴掌道： “跟谁学的？”
“跟妈妈呀，妈妈就是这么跟羯斯噶叔叔说话的，羯斯噶叔叔的脸黑红黑红的，手上的奶疙瘩掉了都不知道。”
“以后不许这样跟人说话！”云初觉得自己的教育任务似乎更加得繁重了。
“妈妈说男人都喜欢女人这样跟他们说话，还要我好好地学呢……”
“我说了——不许学！”
“我不！”
娜哈发怒了，用双手抓住云初的长头发用力地摇晃。
一天打一顿娜哈，这是云初给自己制定的规矩，否则总是调皮犯错的娜哈，一整天都会处在哭泣状态中。
很明显，娜哈也知道哥哥的这个规矩，并且已经掌握的规矩的漏洞，往往在被哥哥殴打过一顿之后，她就会变得越发地嚣张且肆无忌惮。
云初恼怒地拍了拍黑眼窝公羊的脑袋，黑眼窝公羊立刻甩开蹄子跑到队伍最前边，毫不犹豫地朝帐篷那边跑去。
“嗷嗷——”更多的呼喝声响起，更多的牧羊人赶着羊群从各个山坳里钻出来，天山脚下顿时就热闹起来了。
云初背着娜哈回头再看一眼白雪皑皑的天山，这样的景致他已经看了13年，就算是再好的景色也看得有些腻味了。
假如，假如塞来玛真的要进羯斯噶的帐篷，他就想离开这里，去魂牵梦绕的长安看看。
看看书本里的长安变成现实是否如同想象中那样繁盛。
本来就不是回纥人，自然不能掩耳盗铃的认为自己就是回纥人。
再加上，回纥人的生活真的很不适合他。
云初害怕在这里待得时间长了，脑海中那点文明会随着时光一点点的流逝，最终把那些事情统统给忘掉。
一头肥壮的旱獭连滚带爬地从草坡上跑下来，娜哈则第一时间从云初的背上跳下来。
两个几乎一样肥壮的家伙重重地撞在一起，娜哈明显以身高优势取胜，双手勒住旱獭的脖子，焦急地对云初大喊： “哥哥，快点烧火。”

这只旱獭被娜哈勒住脖子挣扎了几下就不动了，原本肥壮的身体自由垂落，就显得有些瘦长。
云初把大肥从娜哈的魔掌里解救出来，这家伙立刻蹲在他的身边 “啾啾”地叫唤，一只爪子还指着虎视眈眈的娜哈发泄着心中的不满。
掏出两颗奶疙瘩喂给了大肥，大肥立刻就忘记了刚才屈辱的一幕。
这家伙就是旱獭群里的女干细，是属于云初一个人的女干细，它毫无族群荣誉感与族群同生共死的自觉。
自从被云初把幼小的它从金凋爪子下拯救下来，又长期在草原上相遇，它对云初的感情要比跟族群的感情更深。
只要云初去牧羊，它就会出现在云初的周围，还会引诱别的旱獭过来，供云初抓住烧着吃。
旱獭是一种很奇怪的动物，对自己同伴的信任几乎是无条件的。
当然，一定要把大肥剔除，它就是旱獭群中的败类。
只要有大肥带领着，它们就会成群结队的过来……这个时候，云初只需要用一个皮口袋套住一只，再给别的旱獭一些食物，这群旱獭在大肥的带领下满意的离去，至于少了一两个同伴它们好像不在乎，也有可能是不识数。
只要云初愿意给，下一次还是会过来讨要奶疙瘩一类高热量食物，至于少一些同伴都是无足轻重的小事情。
旱獭出现的地方，金凋必定会如约
而至，就像只要看到旱獭，娜哈就会流出大量的口水一般正常。
金凋在高空中悄无声息的飞行着，大肥发出凄厉的警告声，这群旱獭立刻就钻进荒草丛，沿着来路再落荒而逃。
云初提着不断晃动的皮口袋跟大肥告别，大肥就再一次站在高处朝云初大叫，多少有些依依不舍。
它们回到洞里的时候或许会把丢失一两个同伴的账算在金凋头上。
娜哈此时已经忘记了哥哥古怪的捕捉旱獭的方法，她只想尽快地回家，好让哥哥把这只旱獭烧给她吃。
旱獭锋利的爪子已经挠破了口袋，云初从黑眼窝的背上取出一根自己削出来的棒球棍，一棍子就把皮口袋里的旱獭给打死了。
黑眼窝自己带着羊群进了羊圈，云初则提着旱獭来到喂羊的水槽边上，准备把这头旱獭给料理掉。
不当一回回纥人，是没有办法理解回纥人对于旱獭肉的热爱的。
云初这个回纥人身份是他那个明明有着一身惨白皮肤，栗色头发，绿眼珠的塞人母亲强加给他的。

塞人之所以能称之为回纥人，是塞人一族个美女，好几万只羊，几千头牛，几百头骆驼，以及几百匹上好的战马换来的。
以前他们还有另外一个名称——九姓铁勒——薛延陀——回纥部落——塞人部落。
之所以会有这么长的名字，完全是因为有着栗色头发，绿色眼珠的塞人谁都打不过。
只要是一个强大的部落，他们都会选择先战斗，然后臣服这样一个过程。
一般情况下，不战斗直接臣服的部族会被人家直接杀死，只有那些有战斗力的部族才会被其余强大的部族接受。
草原上，戈壁上，沙漠上的每一个部族都必须保证自己的扩张行为可以让自己越来越强大，而不是越来越弱小。
塞人的策略则是打得过就打，打不过就加入，塞人可以是匈奴人，可以是突厥人，当然也可以是铁勒人，如果不是昭武九姓的那些国家过于遥远，塞人们其实也讨论过加入他们的话题。
有了回纥人这个身份，就不用担心别的胡人来杀他们，抢他们了，很有安全感。
还多了跟在唐军后边捡便宜牧场，捡便宜牛羊，所以，他们认为投降是一件再正确不过的事情，唯一让人忧虑的是——一个常青树一般强大的老大不好找。
不过，既然选择了投降，那么，被人家奴役也就成了一件理所当然的事情。
塞人每年都要给回纥人缴纳最多的牛羊，最多的物资，承受最重的作战任务，换来的仅仅是回纥人允许他们自称为回纥人。
塞人族好像很满意，塞来玛她们也好像非常地满意，于是，塞人的生活习惯在迅速地向回纥人的生活习惯靠近。
比如——吃旱獭！
这种啮齿目松鼠科的小家伙体型粗大肥壮，颈粗吻阔，耳小眼细，四肢粗短，体内多脂肪，是回纥人眼中不可多得的美味，自然也就成了塞人们最喜欢的食物。
这种事情跟口味一点关系都没有，只跟熘须拍马有关。
想想都知道，在只有盐巴这一种调味品的情况下，旱獭肉即便是再鲜美，又能好吃到哪里去呢？
当然，云初烹调的旱獭肉不在此列！
跟一般的回纥人烧烤跟炖煮旱獭肉不同，云初有自己独特的烹调方式。
在捉住旱獭之后，云初喜欢从旱獭的***把两根棍子伸进去，通过转动将肠子内脏完整的抽出来，由于旱獭的肠子非常得坚韧，这样做的好处就在于不污染旱獭可食用部分。
脏东西抽出来之后再把旱獭的***缝合好，再砍掉旱獭的头，这样就有了一个天然的皮口袋。

这个时候再用刀子插几下旱獭的气管，往里面灌一些添加过盐巴的清水，将可食用的内脏切碎装进去，再放一些天山特有的乌梅，这东西很酸，能很好地释放出旱獭肉的鲜味。
想要吃一顿上好的旱獭肉，白茅草的根是必不可少的，这东西遇热之后就会释放出一种澹澹的，近乎香叶的气息，尤其是跟天山特产孜然混合之后，孜然浓烈的类似狐臭的味道就会被减轻，再与肉类的脂肪反应之后，就只剩下奇香了。
只要把这样的旱獭皮口袋静置半个小时，趁着这个时间在沙地上烧一堆火，往火里丢一些鹅卵石。
等篝火把沙子烧热了，石头烧得滚烫，再把这些烧得滚烫的石头，放进这个封闭的皮囊埋进沙子里炖煮。
这是一种效率很高且能尽量利用热量的烹调方式。
只需要片刻光阴催熟，沙地里埋着的旱獭皮口袋就会冒出炙热的蒸汽，这些蒸汽是从皮口袋的缝隙里射出来的，整个皮口袋这个时候跟一个弱化版的高压锅区别不大。
再耐心地等待半个小时，一个圆滚滚的旱獭皮口袋就出现在人们的面前。
用刀子刮掉烤焦的毛皮，一个黄澄澄的类似挂炉烤鸭的食物就出现在人们的面前。
把这个东西放置在老羊皮上，用刀子轻轻一划，丰富的油脂就会自动冒出来，刀子继续往深处划，紧绷的旱獭皮就会自动朝两边分开，展露出里边丰富的食材，于是——一顿肥美的旱獭大餐就出现在了人们的面前。
最先映入眼帘的是亮晶晶微微泛黄的旱獭的脂肪，这东西用刀子切下来颤巍巍地杵在刀尖上，往嘴里一送，不用咬，就迅速融化在口中，变成液体的脂肪顺着喉咙滚滚而下，等不到它落进胃里，就被饥渴的身体一滴不剩地吸收光了。
趁着身体吸收油脂的功夫，回纥人的眼光已经落在了红色的旱獭心脏，微微发黑的旱獭肝脏上，心脏发脆，极有嚼头，肝脏绵软如同法国鹅肝，放进口中就像是把一块丝绸放进了嘴里，不用嚼，它就能丝滑地落进胃里……
旱獭皮这时候焦脆异常，撒上一点盐巴，放进嘴里，焦脆的外皮就会迅速变软，有一种融化的感觉。
塞来玛之所以喜欢吃旱獭皮，不是没有原因的。
content_en:
"Mom begged Uncle Jiesga to get you a horse, so that you no longer have to ride on the old argali to chase Miman and the others."
Naha's hot breath made Yunchu's ears itch. He slapped Naha on the butt with his backhand and said, "Who did you learn this from?"
"Follow mom, that's how mom talks to Uncle Jiesga. Uncle Jiesga's face is so dark and red that he doesn't even know if the milk bumps on his hands have fallen off."
"Don't talk to people like this in the future!" Yun Chu felt that his educational tasks seemed to be even more arduous.
"Mom said that men like women to talk to them like this, and she wants me to learn from it..."
"I said - no learning!"
"I don't!"
Naha got angry, grabbed Yunchu's long hair with both hands and shook it hard.
Beating Naha once a day was a rule Yunchu set for himself, otherwise Naha, who was always naughty and making mistakes, would be in a state of crying all day long.
Obviously, Naha also knows her brother's rules and has mastered the loopholes in the rules. Often after being beaten by her brother, she will become more arrogant and unscrupulous.
Yun Chu patted the head of the black-eyed ram angrily. The black-eyed ram immediately kicked off its hooves and ran to the front of the team, running towards the tent without hesitation.
"Ouch -" more shouts sounded, and more shepherds drove their sheep out of various mountain cols. The foot of Tianshan Mountain suddenly became lively.
Yun Chu carried Naha on his back and looked back at the snow-capped Tianshan Mountains. He had been looking at this scenery for 13 years, and even the best scenery was a bit boring.
If, if Selema really wants to enter Jiesga's tent, he wants to leave here and go to Chang'an, which is haunted by dreams.
Let’s see if the Chang’an in the books becomes as prosperous as imagined.
You are not a Uighur in the first place, so you can't cover your ears and think that you are a Uighur.
In addition, the life of the Huihe people is really not suitable for him.
Yun Chu was afraid that if he stayed here for a long time, the civilization in his mind would pass by little by little, and eventually he would forget all those things.
A fat marmot rolled down the grass slope, and Naha immediately jumped off Yunchu's back.
Two guys who were almost equally fat bumped into each other hard. Naha obviously won with her height advantage. She strangled the marmot's neck with both hands and shouted anxiously to Yun Chu: "Brother, hurry up and light the fire."
The marmot was strangled by Naha's neck and struggled for a few times before becoming motionless. Its originally fat body hung freely, making it look a little slender.
Yunchu rescued Big Fat from Naha's clutches, and the guy immediately squatted beside him and called out "chirp", pointing one paw at Naha who was staring at him eagerly to vent his dissatisfaction.
He took out two milk lumps and fed them to Dafa. Dafa immediately forgot about the humiliating scene just now.
This guy is the female cadre of the marmot group, a female cadre who belongs to Yunchu alone. She has no sense of honor of the group and the consciousness of living and dying together with the group.
Ever since Yun Chu rescued it as a young child from the claws of Golden Wither and met on the grassland for a long time, its feelings towards Yun Chu were deeper than those towards the tribe.
As long as Yunchu goes to herd sheep, it will appear around Yunchu, and will also lure other marmots over for Yunchu to catch and burn.
Marmots are strange animals that trust their companions almost unconditionally.
Of course, the big fat one must be removed, it is the scum of the marmot group.
As long as Da Fei leads them, they will come in groups... At this time, Yunchu only needs to use a leather bag to cover one of the marmots, and then give some food to the other marmots. Under the leadership of Da Fei, this group of marmots left with satisfaction. As for the lack of one or two companions, they didn't seem to care, or maybe they didn't know how to count.
As long as Yun Chu is willing to give it, he will still come over next time to ask for a piece of breast milk.Such high-calorie food, as for missing some companions is a trivial matter.
Wherever the marmot appears, gold will surely follow its promise
And it is normal for Naha to drool a lot whenever she sees a marmot.
Jin Zhui was flying silently in the high air, and Da Fei let out a shrill warning sound. The group of marmots immediately got into the grass and fled along the way they came.
Yun Chu said goodbye to Da Fei with the leather bag that kept shaking, and Da Fei once again stood on a high place and shouted to Yun Chu, somewhat reluctantly.
When they return to the cave, they may blame the loss of one or two companions on the golden head.
At this time, Naha had forgotten her brother's weird method of catching marmots. She just wanted to go home as soon as possible so that her brother could burn the marmot for her to eat.
The marmot's sharp claws had scratched the pocket. Yunchu took out a baseball bat he had cut out from the back of the black eye socket, and beat the marmot to death in the leather pocket with one blow.
Black Eye socket took the sheep into the sheep pen by himself, while Yun Chu carried the marmot to the sheep feeding trough, preparing to take care of the marmot.
If you are not a Huihe person, you cannot understand the Huihe people's love for marmot meat.
Yunchu's identity as a Uighur was forced upon him by his mother, who was a Cypriot with pale skin, chestnut hair, and green eyes.
The reason why the Cypriots can be called Uighurs is that they exchanged for a beautiful woman, tens of thousands of sheep, thousands of cattle, hundreds of camels, and hundreds of fine war horses.
In the past, they had another name - Jiuxing Tiele - Xue Yantuo - Uihe tribe - Sai tribe.
The reason why he has such a long name is simply because no one can beat Sai with chestnut hair and green eyes.
As long as it is a powerful tribe, they will choose to fight first and then surrender.
Under normal circumstances, tribes that surrender directly without fighting will be killed directly by others, and only those tribes with fighting ability will be accepted by other powerful tribes.
Every tribe on the grasslands, Gobi, and desert must ensure that their expansion behavior can make themselves stronger and stronger, rather than weaker and weaker.
The Cypriots' strategy is to fight if they can win, and join if they can't. The Cypriots can be Huns, Turks, or of course Tiele people. If the countries with the nine surnames of Zhaowu were not too far away, the Cypriots would actually have discussed joining them.
With the identity of Huihe people, we don’t have to worry about other barbarians coming to kill or rob them, which gives us a sense of security.
They also followed the Tang army to pick up cheap pastures and cheap cattle and sheep. Therefore, they believed that surrender was the right thing to do. The only worrying thing was that it was difficult to find a boss as powerful as an evergreen tree.
However, since he chose to surrender, being enslaved by others became a matter of course.
Every year, the Cypriots pay the most cattle and sheep, the most materials, and bear the heaviest combat tasks to the Uighurs. In exchange, the Uighurs only allow them to call themselves Uighurs.
The Cypriots seem to be very satisfied, and Selema and the others also seem to be very satisfied. Therefore, the living habits of the Cypriots are rapidly approaching those of the Uighurs.
For example - eating marmots!
This little rodent, Squirrelidae, has a thick and fat body, a thick neck, a broad snout, small ears and thin eyes, thick and short limbs, and a lot of fat in the body. It is a rare delicacy in the eyes of the Uighur people, and naturally it has become the Sai people's favorite food.
This kind of thing has nothing to do with taste, only to do with flattery.
Just think about it, if there is only salt as a condiment, how delicious is the marmot meat, no matter how delicious it is?
Of course, the marmot meat cooked by Yun Chu is not included in this list!
Different from the common Uighur barbecues and stewed marmot meat, Yunchu has its own unique cooking method.
existAfter catching the marmot, Yunchu likes to insert two sticks into the marmot's vagina and pull out the entire intestines by turning them. Since the intestines of the marmot are very tough, the advantage of doing this is that it does not contaminate the edible parts of the marmot.
After the dirt is extracted, the marmot's vagina is sewn up, and then the marmot's head is chopped off, so that there is a natural leather pocket.
At this time, insert a knife into the marmot's trachea a few times, pour some salted water into it, chop up the edible offal and put it in, and then add some Tianshan unique ebony plums, which are very sour and can well release the umami flavor of the marmot meat.
If you want to eat a good meal of marmot meat, the root of Imperata cogongrass is indispensable. When it is heated, it will release a faint smell, almost fragrant. Especially when mixed with cumin, a specialty of Tianshan, the strong smell of cumin similar to body odor will be reduced, and after reacting with the fat of the meat, only a strange fragrance will remain.
Just let such a marmot-skin bag sit for half an hour, while you make a fire in the sand and throw some pebbles into the fire.
When the bonfire heats up the sand and the stones become very hot, the hot stones are put into the closed skin bag and buried in the sand to stew.
This is a very efficient cooking method that maximizes the use of heat.
It only takes a moment to ripen, and the marmot skin bag buried in the sand will emit hot steam. The steam is shot out from the gaps in the leather bag. At this time, the entire leather bag is not much different from a weakened version of a pressure cooker.
After waiting patiently for another half hour, a round marmot skin bag appeared in front of people.
Use a knife to scrape off the burnt fur, and a bright yellow food similar to a hanging oven roast duck appears in front of people.
Place this thing on the old sheepskin and lightly scratch it with a knife, and the rich oil will come out automatically. If you continue to scratch it deeper with the knife, the tight marmot skin will automatically separate to both sides, revealing the rich ingredients inside, and then - a plump marmot feast will appear in front of people.
The first thing that catches the eye is the glistening and slightly yellowed marmot fat. This thing is cut off with a knife and placed tremblingly on the tip of the knife. Once it is put into the mouth, it quickly melts in the mouth without biting. The liquid fat rolls down the throat. Before it can fall into the stomach, it is absorbed by the hungry body.
While the body was absorbing the oil, the Huihe people's eyes had already fallen on the red marmot heart and the slightly black marmot liver. The heart was brittle and extremely chewy. The liver was as soft as French foie gras. Putting it in your mouth was like putting a piece of silk into your mouth. Without chewing, it fell into the stomach smoothly...
The marmot skin is extremely crispy at this time. Sprinkle a little salt and put it in your mouth, and the crispy skin will quickly become soft and have a melting feeling.
There is a reason why Selema likes to eat marmot skins.
